May 26, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Rockefeller Financial Services Inc decreased its stake in Becton Dickinson & Co. (BDX) by 18.37% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Rockefeller Financial Services Inc sold 90,476 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.94% with the market. The institutional investor held 402,038 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $86.06M, down from 492,514 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Rockefeller Financial Services Inc who had been investing in Becton Dickinson & Co. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $59.78B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.83% or $1.87 during the last trading session, reaching $223.73. About 1.03M shares traded. Becton, Dickinson and Company (NYSE:BDX) has risen 15.92% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 4.37% the S&P500.
